findings.title: Estimates go out and nothing follows them
findings.detail: Your site takes estimate requests through a form, and the confirmation is the last thing a customer hears. Shops we look at recover between a fifth and a third of quiet estimates with follow-up alone, and the work is already priced.

findings.title: The phone number is an image on mobile
findings.detail: On a phone the number in your header is part of a graphic, so tapping it does nothing. A customer standing in a parking lot has to read it, switch apps, and type it in.

findings.title: Nobody answers after 5pm, and the page says you close at 5
findings.detail: Collision calls come in right after the accident, which is mostly evenings and weekends. There is no way to leave a request that reaches you before the next morning.

findings.title: Twenty-two reviews, none from this year
findings.detail: Your rating is good and the page is stale, which reads worse than a lower rating kept current. There is no step in your process that asks a finished customer for one.
